Short title and commencement

Act No
Act No. XVI of 1948
Arbitral Tribunal
(Dissolution) Act, 1948.
An Act to repeal the Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947, and dissolve the
Arbitral Tribunal set up there under:
Whereas the Arbitral Tribunal set up in pursuance of the Arbitral Tribunal
Order, 1947, has disposed of all reference made to it under the provisions of
that Order;
It is hereby enacted as follows
1. Short title
and commencement.-
(1) This Act may be called the Arbitral Tribunal
(Dissolution) Act, 1948.
(2) It shall have and be deemed to have had effect
first day of May, 1948.

Repeal of the Arbitral Tribunal Order and dissolution of Arbitral Tribunal

Act No
Act No. XVI of 1948
Arbitral Tribunal
(Dissolution) Act, 1948.
An Act to repeal the Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947, and dissolve the
Arbitral Tribunal set up there under:
Whereas the Arbitral Tribunal set up in pursuance of the Arbitral Tribunal
Order, 1947, has disposed of all reference made to it under the provisions of
that Order;
It is hereby enacted as follows
2. Repeal of the
Arbitral Tribunal Order and dissolution of Arbitral Tribunal.--
The Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947, is hereby
repealed, and the Arbitral Tribunal set up there under is hereby dissolved
Provided that neither the said repeal nor the said
dissolution shall effect the validity of any award made by the said Tribunal
under the provisions of the said Order, and every such award shall continue to
be binding on all parties and persons directly or indirectly concerned in, or
affected by the award.
[Note.-An award made before the first day of May,
1948 is a good award, and therefore, enforceable at law. This Act does not effect the validity of such award.]
